# Skrim Watercolors

> Skrim Watercolors is an innovative, eco-friendly manufacturer of artist-grade watercolor paints based in Germany, offering premium paint sets, refills, and wholesale solutions for artists and retailers worldwide.

Skrim Watercolors specializes in sustainable, high-quality watercolor paints including specialty collections like the Bombastico Box and Mother of Pearls series. The company serves both individual artists and B2B resellers across Europe, North America, and the Asia-Pacific region.

## Key Topics

- Artist-grade watercolor paints
- Sustainable/eco-friendly production
- Skrim Bombastico Box
- Mother of Pearls collection
- Product bundles and sets
- Reseller/wholesale program
- International shipping
- Pigment colors
- Metallic and shimmer paints
- Germany-based manufacturer
- Skrim GmbH
- DHL delivery
- Customer testimonials
- Refill options
- Premium paint collections
